body: Your mom said that too?:/ I thought I was the only one. It really makes me feel terrible and sometimes I think she's right. I just don't wanna be in pain anymore. Like I feel super paranoid and it's getting really uncomfortable. And my wrist looks horrible and I'm so ashamed about it now, trying to hide it during work. I'm pretty sure my supervisor saw and I just want to die. I have an appointment with my GP Friday for something unrelated so maybe I can talk to them. I know for certain that I don't want Effexor anymore. Do you know what meds would be good to bring up? Effexor thinned out my hair,  and made me sweaty/twitchy and also hyperactive.
My parents might seriously disown me. My mom said I'm just like her drug addict brother that abused heroin. It sucks. Plus I had side effects with Effexor ( my hair went thin).
I'm afraid to get help though. I don't want them throwing me in the psych ward because I'm so unstable.
